notes.title: Demo v0.4.7 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2]✨ Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Mouse wheel zooming is now centered around the mouse cursor instead of the center of the screen, so you can point-and-zoom and it will magnify the area where you are pointing.[/p][/*][*][p]Magnify and pan gestures are now supported (e.g. from a MacBook trackpad).[/p][/*][/list][h2]🪲 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][i]Demolish Everything[/i] button is no longer clickable while it is hidden (the keyboard shortcut continues to works regardless of the button visibility).[/p][/*][*][p]When going to the settings menu or main menu while Demolish mode is active, the cursor now changes back from the demolish cursor to the regular mouse cursor.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🛠️ Internal Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The game engine has been upgraded to Godot 4.4.1, bringing some upstream performance improvements and bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.4.6 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2]✨ Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]The number of daily delivered parcels is now visible even in Chill Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Cannon and Gravity Well descriptions had their wording updated to better explain what the buildings can and cannot do.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial has been updated to mention that Freeze buttons also freeze upgrade costs between days.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🪲 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Font issues on the Steam Deck have been fixed. This involved disabling fallback to system fonts on all platforms, so please let us know if you encounter any other font-rendering issues.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: The number of daily delivered parcels is now visible even in Chill Mode.
Cannon and Gravity Well descriptions had their wording updated to better explain what the buildings can and cannot do.
Tutorial has been updated to mention that Freeze buttons also freeze upgrade costs between days.

tags.bug: Font issues on the Steam Deck have been fixed. This involved disabling fallback to system fonts on all platforms, so please let us know if you encounter any other font-rendering issues.

notes.title: Demo v0.4.5 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2]🖼️ Visual Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Days now begin and end at noon instead of at midnight -- we have heard your feedback that the lighting and shadows look a lot better during the day and people spend a lot of time in the paused state at the end of one day and the start of another, and of course we would like to present the game in the best [i]light.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Shadow quality was improved, especially on the Arctic Shores biome.[/p][/*][*][p]Soft shadow quality can now be configured in the settings.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 📮 Puffin Parcel Post Demo Lands on May 20!
notes.content:
[h2]📯Dear future postmaster,[/h2]

We're thrilled to welcome you to our very first Steam community post for [b]Puffin Parcel Post[/b]! Our team has been stamping away at development, and we're excited to share some special delivery news with you.

[h2]🎮 Special Delivery: Demo Arrives May 20th![/h2]

Mark your calendars! Our free demo will be landing in your Steam library on May 20th. You'll finally get your chance to build a postal empire where puffins handle the heavy lifting! Place buildings strategically, manage deliveries, and watch as your feathered workforce zips across the map with important parcels.
In the demo, you'll get to:
[list]
[*] Build and optimize your own postal network from scratch
[*] Unlock perks and upgrades that'll change how you play
[*] Tackle delivery challenges in our first environment
[*] Meet our hardworking puffin postal team (no stamps required!)
[/list]

[h2]📺 First-Class Preview: Demo Announcement Trailer[/h2]

Want a sneak peek at your future postal empire? In case you haven't seen it yet, check it out on YouTube and share it with friends who might enjoy joining our postal service!

[previewyoutube=4qW8Mwq89PU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🔍 Can't Wait for Delivery? Join Our Discord![/h2]

Too excited to wait until May 20th? We get it! Join our Discord server where we sometimes look for playtesters. Our most active [b]community members might find themselves sorting parcels earlier than expected[/b]... 🔑📦

Our Discord is where all the behind-the-scenes action happens:
[list]
[*] Regular development updates with fresh screenshots and videos
[*] Direct line to our development team
[*] A place to share your feedback and suggestions
[*] And occasional special surprises (no postage due!)
[/list]

[h2][url=https://discord.gg/m5jHYwpv5w][b]Join the Puffin Postal Service Discord![/b][/url][/h2]

Thanks for your interest in Puffin Parcel Post! We can't wait to see what you'll build. Keep an eye on this mailbox for more updates as we approach the demo release! 📭

Yours sincerely,
The Puffin Parcel Post Team

[hr][/hr] 

[i]P.S. If you haven't already, please wishlist our game! Every wishlist helps our puffins deliver this game to more addresses![/i]
